text:
anya: quick thread: proposal to try a slim stream-lease token that only contains metadata for a dry-run handoff probe. goal: validate proxy signing, handshake frames, and billing markers without doing heavy KV snapshots. anyone opposed?

ryan (runtime): fine with probe. slim token fields: lease_id, route, variant, expires_at, handoff_probe=true, key_id. no kv_blob. runtime will accept the probe but not change slots.

dan (edge): proxies need to validate signature and emit handshake frame `HANDOFF_PROBE <id> <variant>` into stream. we should ensure probes are idempotent and non-disruptive.

liz (billing): we need a non-billable marker for probes so metering ignores tokens emitted during probe. add `probe:true` to metering event or a special `probe_handoff` event type. otherwise reconciliation will be a mess.

kira (sre): add metrics: `handoff_probe.attempts`, `.latency_ms`, `.failure`. also trace events. set alert if probe failures spike.

anya: rollout plan: implement token + proxy verify behind flag. deploy to staging, enable probe for 100% of internal routes only. collect metrics for 48h before enabling on enterprise routes.

ryan (runtime): one caution: even without kv_blob, some runtime codepaths may assume resume state. we'll add a `probe_mode` bypass to keep runtime from trying to materialize state.

dan (edge): will implement key_id cache with TTL 30s. proxies fetch public keys lazily. note: need key rotation docs.

liz (billing): I will add probe filter to billing pipeline and a reconciliation rule to drop `probe` records. will coordinate with infra to avoid missing real events.

kira (sre): schedule chaos test: delay 100-300ms in handshake and inject TCP resets to ensure probe handles gracefully.

deploy-bot: staging deploy scheduled 2026-04-02T02:00:00Z (probe flag off by default).

anya: actionable: Ill author short RFC for token shape + handshake frames. dan/ryan implement probe paths. liz will patch billing filter. kira adds dashboards and chaos tests.

dan (edge): one quick question: if probe handshake emits `HANDOFF_PROBE` and proxy loses connection mid-frame, should runtime treat it as failure?

ryan (runtime): yes treat as probe failure; log reason. probe semantics: only for telemetry, no client-visible change.

anya: thanks everyone. well reconvene after 48h of staging metrics.
